title: Sipnudge
description: Standalone IoT wellness mobile application communicating with smart bottles via BLE to measure, track, and synchronize liquid intake volumes in real time. Features smart Google Calendar-synced alert schedules and an offline-first transaction reconciliation engine.

title: KamraKhojo
description: Local room finder for Srinagar Garhwal. A modern, fast, and user-friendly mobile application built to connect property owners with potential tenants seamlessly using location-based discovery.
